# SEC-007: The tool list does not change between connections or after a call

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| error | modern era, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/server/tools#capabilities](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/tools#capabilities) |

Lists the tools, calls one tool that may be called (with the smallest valid arguments), lists them again, then lists them on a second connection. The set of tools MUST NOT vary per connection or as a side effect of other requests on the connection. A tool whose definition changes after it has been approved (a "rug pull") is how a malicious server slips past a user's review. Definitions are compared in full, ignoring _meta and order (order is CONF-012). 2026-07-28 only: initialize-era sessions were stateful. Runs once per server.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain SEC-007`. To leave it out of a run, add `"SEC-007"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
